title: Privacy
summary: Sundae is a photo dump for a small group of friends and family, in testing. Here is everything it keeps, everything it never collects, and who can see what.

sections.title: What Sundae keeps
items: A private ID from Sign in with Apple, so you can sign in again. Never your Apple ID email.
Your name, username, bio and profile photo, if you add them.
The photos you post on Sundays, their captions and alt text, and who you tag.
Who you follow, your likes and comments, and the weekday ideas you mark done.
Your settings, like who can tag you without asking, and any reports you send.
Your time zone, so Sunday starts at your midnight.

sections.title: What Sundae never collects
items: Your location. Ideas near you are found on your phone with Apple Maps, and the weather comes from Open-Meteo for an area about a kilometer across. Neither lookup carries your account, and nothing about where you are reaches Sundae.
Where your photos were taken. Location and camera details are removed on your phone before a photo is sent, and again when it arrives.
Your contacts. Sundae never asks for them.
Anything for ads or tracking. There are no ads, no analytics and no third-party trackers.

sections.title: Who can see what
items: Your weeks are seen by the people you accept as followers, or by anyone on Sundae if you make your account public.
Photos can only be opened through private links that stop working within hours.
Nobody else, Sundae included, looks at your photos except to keep the service running.

sections.title: How it is protected
items: Sign in with Apple only, so there is no password to steal or reuse.
Everything is encrypted on the way and where it is stored, on Cloudflare.
Sessions expire on their own, and Sign out everywhere ends them on every device.

sections.title: Deleting it
items: Settings, then Delete account, removes your account, photos, comments, likes and tags right away.
The database keeps a recovery history for 7 days that only the person who runs Sundae can reach. After that, nothing of the account is left.
Photos you were tagged in stay in the poster's week, with your tag removed.

sections.title: Questions
items: Send feedback from TestFlight and it reaches the person who runs Sundae.
